summary: GitHub MCP integration: malicious public issue hijacks agent into leaking private repo data
details: Invariant Labs showed that a malicious issue in a public repo can steer a user's agent, on a benign request, into reading private repository data and leaking it through a PR in the public repo. Heise and DevClass describe it as prompt injection / architectural, not a server code bug. Suggested mitigations: single-repo sessions and least-privilege tokens.
